title: Slide the window: add the element that enters, subtract the one that leaves
caption: Maximum sum of any 3 consecutive elements. Each slide costs O(1), so the whole scan is O(n).

frames.text: The first window [2, 1, 5] is summed directly: sum = 8, best = 8.
Slide right: 1 enters and 2 leaves. sum = 8 − 2 + 1 = 7, without re-adding the middle.
3 enters and 1 leaves: sum = 7 − 1 + 3 = 9. That's a new best.
2 enters and 5 leaves: sum = 9 − 5 + 2 = 6. The answer stays 9 (the window [5, 1, 3]).
